source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) closes, you can mark a [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) enemy unit no more than **12″** from the Tranceweaver. For the rest of the turn, **Slaanesh Legiones Daemonica** models in your army may re-roll their [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) and [Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) individually against that unit.
